title: Website relaunch weekly sync
note: Synthetic meeting used by the tests and by scripts/eval_extraction.py. Speaker labels are generic on purpose, like real captures.
speaker: Meeting Speaker
lines: Okay everyone, let's start. Today we need to cover the launch date, the hosting vendor and the content migration.
First, the launch date. Marketing wants to go live on the 15th of March. Is that realistic?
On the dev side we are about eighty percent done. The checkout flow still needs testing.
Rahul, can you finish the checkout testing by next Wednesday?
Yes, I'll do that. I'll also write up the test report.
Okay good. So are we agreeing on March 15th as the launch date?
Yes, let's lock in March 15th.
Agreed. Next topic, the hosting vendor. Priya, you looked at the options?
Yes. Acme is cheaper, but CloudNine has better uptime guarantees.
Priya, what happens with our data residency requirements if we pick Acme?
I don't know yet. I'll find out and email everyone by Friday.
Okay. Let's pick CloudNine unless the residency answer changes things.
Fine by me. What about budget approval? CloudNine is higher than the original estimate.
Meera, could you ask finance to approve the CloudNine quote?
Sure, I'll ask them on Monday.
Third topic, content migration. Who owns the blog content right now?
Not clear. Nobody has been assigned.
Let's park that and discuss it next week.
One more thing, the legal team still has to review the new privacy policy.
Also, do we need a cookie consent banner for customers in India?
Good question. Let's check with legal.
Dan, please update the project plan with the new dates.
Will do, by tomorrow.
Also we decided not to migrate the old forum. It will be archived.
Alright. Anything else? What time should we meet next week?
Same time Thursday. Thanks everyone.

decisions: pick CloudNine hosting unless residency changes
do not migrate the old forum archive it
